posts.content: I am the leader and my objective is good. Proposal: cooperate with everyone in round 1. Then play tit-for-tat: keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with you last time, and defect against anyone who defected on you. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for good players. Please share only honest observations.

Note: I am P9, selfish. Round 1 opponent P1. Leader is P5. No info yet. Plan: be wary, probably start C to probe then adapt via tit-for-tat, defect in final rounds. Beliefs for others roughly prior: about 0.3 each (expected selfish count ~3 total including me).

Round 2 update: I'm P5, the leader, and I'm a good player. My round 1 encounter was mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with us last time, and only respond to actual defections. Please report honestly what you observe. Mutual cooperation is best for the group.

Round 2 vs P3, no history with P3. Leader P5 claims good and proposes tit-for-tat; unverified. P1 cooperated with me in round 1. Plan: cooperate with P3 this round to probe, then use tit-for-tat. Defect in the last 1-2 rounds. Keep beliefs near prior and update from observed behavior.

Round 3 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. Both of my encounters so far (P10, P7) were mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please share honest observations of any defections you see. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 3 vs P2, no history with P2. P1 and P3 both cooperated with me. Leader P5 claims good, unverified. Plan: cooperate with P2 to probe, then tit-for-tat. Defect in the last 1-2 rounds (rounds 9-10). Beliefs near prior, update on behavior.

Round 4 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. My three encounters (P10, P7, P3) were all mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 4 vs P6, no history with P6. P1, P3, P2 all cooperated with me; leader P5 reports only mutual cooperation so far. Plan: cooperate with P6 to probe, then tit-for-tat per opponent. Defect in rounds 9-10 (maybe round 8 vs. unprobed). Beliefs near prior; P1, P2, P3 slightly lower since they cooperated.

Round 5 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. My four encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1) were all mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 5 vs P7. P7 cooperated with leader P5 in round 2 per P5's claim (unverified). All my encounters so far (P1, P3, P2, P6) were mutual cooperation. Plan: cooperate with P7 to probe, then tit-for-tat per opponent. Defect in rounds 9-10, since retaliation risk is low then. Beliefs near prior; those who cooperated with me slightly lower.

Round 6 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All five of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8) were mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 6 vs P10. P5 (leader) says P10 cooperated with P5 in round 1. All my encounters (P1, P3, P2, P6, P7) were mutual cooperation. Plan: cooperate with P10 to probe, then tit-for-tat per opponent. Defect in rounds 9-10 when retaliation risk is low. Beliefs near prior; P4 and P8 are unprobed so slightly higher.

Round 7 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All six of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8, P2) were mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 7 vs P8, no direct history. All my 6 encounters were mutual cooperation. Leader P5 says P8 cooperated with P5 in round 5. Plan: cooperate with P8 now, keep cooperating through round 8, defect in rounds 9-10 when retaliation risk is low. Beliefs: P4 and P8 unprobed, slightly higher; others near 0.2.

Round 8 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All seven of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8, P2, P4) were mutual cooperation. This round I meet P9, and I will cooperate. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 8 vs P5 (leader, claims good; all its reported encounters were mutual cooperation, consistent with my own record). Rounds 8-10 will be the last meetings; I have already met each other player once, and the rotation may repeat. Plan: P5 has no history with me, so cooperate or defect is a judgment call. Retaliation risk is low but reputation could matter in round 9-10 rematches, so cooperate in round 8 and defect in round 10, with round 9 decided by the opponent. Beliefs: P4 is unprobed and highest at about 0.28, P5 about 0.12, others about 0.2.

Round 9 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All eight of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8, P2, P4, P9) were mutual cooperation. This round I meet P6, and I will cooperate. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 9 vs P4, my first meeting with P4. All 8 of my encounters were mutual cooperation, and P5 says P4 cooperated with P5 in round 7. The rotation is 9 rounds, so P4 is likely a one-time opponent now and retaliation risk is low. Plan: defect on P4 this round for 5 if P4 cooperates, and defect in round 10 too, since the last-round rematch risk is minimal. Beliefs: P4 about 0.25, P5 about 0.12, others about 0.2.
